Two bounds found while checking the above, recorded here because a measurement that hides its own limits reads as a clean bill of health. First, one file in this layer is NOT covered by it: pending-captures.md writes its anchors as bare `:NNNN` after a single full-path introduction, which the path:line tokenizer here cannot see. That gap is why the eight `packages/cli/src/cli.ts` anchors in its "How to drain them" section survived pointing at unrelated lines — the dispatch `case 'distill':` is at :6940, not the :6747 it read, and the usage string at :7060, not :6762; they were corrected by direct measurement at 3434c19f on 2026-09-24. Second, this measurement compares the text a line holds at two revisions, so it detects an anchor that MOVED and cannot detect one that resolves to the wrong thing at BOTH — a stale number landing on unrelated code is counted stable. Only reading the row the anchor names catches that class.
anchorDriftAtHead.reading: Every moved anchor resolves to the symbol the file names AT THE STAMP — that is what the stamp is for, and none of the 25 is a defect against this layer's contract.
